{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hansen FeatherTouch''' was a [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]] noted for its precise operations. Turret-mounted, it allowed for it to be used for several different tasks. The ''[[Worthless Fool]]'' had a pair of FeatherTouchs installed.
